card.statement:
Let $\sigma$ be a symmetric shift matrix $\nu=(\nu_{1},\dots,\nu_{m})$ an admissible shape and let $\mathfrak{c}_{n}(\sigma)$ denote the shifted current algebra. Then $S(\mathfrak{c}_{n}(\sigma))$ is Poisson generated by

$\begin{array}[]{l}\{d_{a,i,j;r}\mid 1\leq a\leq m,1\leq i,j\leq\nu_{a}, 0\leq r\}

\hskip 60.0pt\cup\{e_{a,i,j;r}\mid 1\leq a

subject to relations

(5.12)

$\displaystyle\big\{d_{a,i,j;r},d_{b,h,k;s}\big\}=\delta_{a,b}(\delta_{h,j}d_{a,i,k;r+s}-\delta_{i,k}d_{a,h,j;r+s})$

(5.13)

$\displaystyle\big\{e_{a,i,j;r},f_{b,h,k;s}\big\}=\delta_{a,b}(\delta_{h,j}d_{a,i,k;r+s}-\delta_{i,k}d_{a+1,h,j;r+s})$

(5.14)

$\displaystyle\big\{d_{a,i,j;r},e_{b,h,k;s}\big\}=\delta_{a,b}\delta_{h,j}e_{a,i,k;r+s}-\delta_{a,b+1}\delta_{i,k}e_{b,h,j;r+s},$

(5.15)

$\displaystyle\big\{d_{a,i,j;r},f_{b,h,k;s}\big\}=\delta_{a,b+1}\delta_{h,j}f_{b,i,k;r+s}-\delta_{a,b}\delta_{i,k}f_{a,h,j;r+s},$

(5.16)

$\displaystyle\big\{e_{a,i,j;r},e_{a+1,h,k;s+1}\big\}-\big\{e_{a,i,j;r+1},e_{a+1,h,k;s}\big\}=0,$

(5.17)

$\displaystyle\big\{f_{a,i,j;r},f_{a+1,h,k;s+1}\big\}-\big\{f_{a,i,j;r+1},f_{a+1,h,k;s}\big\}=0,$

(5.18)

$\displaystyle\big\{e_{a,i,j;r},e_{b,h,k;s}\big\}=0\text{ for }|i-j|\neq 1\text{ or if }b=a+1\text{ and }h\neq j,$

(5.19)

$\displaystyle\big\{f_{a,i,j;r},f_{b,h,k;s}\big\}=0\text{ for }|i-j|\neq 1\text{ or if }b=a+1\text{ and }i\neq k,$

(5.20)

$\displaystyle\Big\{e_{a,i,j;r_{1}},\big\{e_{a,h,k;r_{2}},e_{b,f,g;r_{3}}\big\}\Big\}+\Big\{e_{a,i,j;r_{2}},\big\{e_{a,h,k;r_{1}},e_{b,g,f;r_{3}}\big\}\Big\}=0\text{ for }|a-b|=1,$

(5.21)

$\displaystyle\Big\{f_{a,i,j;r_{1}},\big\{f_{a,h,k;r_{2}},f_{b,g,f;r_{3}}\big\}\Big\}+\Big\{f_{a,i,j;r_{2}},\big\{f_{a,h,k;r_{1}},f_{b,g,f;r_{3}}\big\}\Big\}=0\text{ for }|a-b|=1.$

paper.title: Shifted twisted Yangians and Slodowy slices in classical Lie algebras
paper.abstract: In this paper we introduce the shifted twisted Yangian of type {\sf AI}, following the work of Lu--Wang--Zhang, and we study their semiclassical limits, a class of Poisson algebras. We demonstrate that they coincide with the Dirac reductions of the semiclassical shifted Yangian for $\mathfrak{gl}_n$. We deduce that these shifted twisted Yangians admit truncations which are isomorphic to Slodowy slices for many non-rectangular nilpotent elements in types {\sf B}, {\sf C}, {\sf D}. As a direct consequence we obtain parabolic presentations of the semiclassical shifted twisted Yangian, analogous to those introduced by Brundan--Kleshchev for the Yangian of type {\sf A}. Finally we give Poisson presentations of Slodowy slices for all even nilpotent elements in types {\sf B}, {\sf C}, {\sf D}, generalising the recent work of the second author.
